items.title: Bringing AI code governance into Kiro with Qodo
items.summary: AI coding agents now write code faster than pull request reviews can keep up. The Qodo Kiro power brings independent, context-aware code review into Kiro, so developers can check agent-generated code against their organization's standards and wider codebase before a pull request opens. This post explains how Kiro powers work, how Qodo's review loop runs inside the IDE, and how Qodo runs its inference on Amazon Bedrock. Teams keep one consistent quality bar across every change, whichever agent wrote it.
items.creator: Len Gomes
